items.statement: The submitted calculation uses the uniquely identified neutral compound-1 B2N6 molecule and verifies its structure before electronic-structure calculations.
items.expected: Identity evidence records CCDC 2512981 provenance, resulting atom count and C18H26B2N6 formula, charge 0, singlet multiplicity 1, deterministic preprocessing, and verified B2N6/tolyl connectivity.

items.statement: The ground-state structure is optimized and the excited-state calculation is based on a converged geometry with reproducible state-selection evidence.
items.expected: The report documents optimization convergence, states whether a frequency/Hessian check was performed, reports starting-structure/conformer coverage and limitations, and lists enough singlet states, including neighboring states or equivalent evidence, to justify the selected dominant visible state.

items.statement: The dominant compound-1 singlet excitation has the source-reported SI energy.
items.expected: 3.0119 eV for the dominant first singlet state.

items.statement: The dominant compound-1 singlet excitation has the source-reported oscillator strength.
The selected dominant visible transition is principally HOMO-LUMO in character and is associated with the N6-centred pi system.
items.expected: The report identifies HOMO-LUMO character, with N6-pi-dominated HOMO/LUMO interpretation, while acknowledging any method-dependent orbital analysis.
